eps.o: As Curtis goes head-to-head with the CIA over a secret tape, he's forced to confront secrets of his own.
After a dead Loch Ness monster washes ashore, Curtis, Banks, and O'Doyle investigate a secret monster prison in the Bermuda Triangle.
Curtis gets invited to his ex-wife's inauguration gala. Banks and O'Doyle must undergo a job evaluation at a fully-immersive offsite facility.
After finding an addendum on the Louisiana Purchase receipt, Curtis must race against old enemies and friends to hold control of the territory.
After butting heads with his own Party, Curtis visits Camp David to undergo a true test of his Presidential prowess.
When America faces a national energy crisis, Curtis and his team venture deep into Hollow Earth to find a solution.
Banks gets malware, and O'Doyle enters her brain to find a fix. Curtis gives the ghost of Lincoln a gift that lets him settle his unfinished business.
A robbery at Fort Knox puts Curtis and the FBI on a manhunt for the culprit, forcing O'Doyle to confront figures from his past.
With Christmas spirit at an all-time low, Curtis attempts to find a fix by deploying a group of synthetic beings, custom-designed to spread cheer.
When a murderous American legend resurfaces, Curtis rises to the challenge -- but doing so proves to be the ultimate test of his public image.
